name: Belt
summary: Leather belt loosely coiled into an oval with a metal buckle and holes; for fashion, clothing and dressing scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the coil rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the belt is about 540 px wide; use about 0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: sway = the coil rocks slightly; pop = it springs in once
